inputs.question: What is Magnify?

outputs.expected_answer: Magnify is an AI automation agency based in Accra, Ghana. It specializes in AI chatbots, automated content generation, and workflow integrations, helping businesses reduce manual work, scale, and improve efficiency.

inputs.question: When was Magnify founded, and what was its mission?

outputs.expected_answer: Magnify was founded in 2023. Its mission is to make advanced AI automation accessible to businesses of all sizes across Africa and globally.

inputs.question: Where is Magnify based?

outputs.expected_answer: Magnify is headquartered in Accra, Ghana, and works with clients globally through remote collaboration and digital delivery.

inputs.question: What are Magnify's three core services?

outputs.expected_answer: Magnify's three core services are AI chatbots, automated content generation, and workflow integrations.

inputs.question: Can Magnify build a custom AI solution that is outside its three core services?

outputs.expected_answer: Yes. Magnify says it can design custom AI solutions around a business's specific requirements. It recommends contacting the agency to discuss the needs.

inputs.question: What can Magnify's chatbots do?

outputs.expected_answer: They can answer customer questions, qualify sales leads and book appointments, recommend products, handle and escalate support tickets, process orders and track shipments, onboard employees, collect feedback, and integrate with CRM, helpdesk, and business tools.

inputs.question: Which platforms can Magnify chatbots work on?

outputs.expected_answer: Our chatbots can work on websites, WhatsApp Business, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, Slack, Telegram, and custom mobile apps.

inputs.question: What chatbot accuracy does Magnify report?

outputs.expected_answer: Our chatbots typically achieve 85–95% accuracy depending on the complexity of the questions. This isn't a guarantee for every use case.

inputs.question: Which languages can Magnify chatbots support?

outputs.expected_answer: We can configure chatbots for English, French, Twi, Ga, and other major African and international languages.

inputs.question: How long does a chatbot project take at each level?

outputs.expected_answer: A basic chatbot typically takes 1–2 weeks; an advanced chatbot with integrations takes 3–4 weeks; and an enterprise chatbot with custom AI training takes 4–8 weeks.

inputs.question: What information does Magnify need to build a chatbot?

outputs.expected_answer: To build your chatbot, we'll need your common customer questions, the processes you want to automate, any existing documentation, access to relevant systems, and your brand voice guidelines.

inputs.question: Can Magnify connect a chatbot to HubSpot and Google Calendar?

outputs.expected_answer: Yes. We support HubSpot CRM and Google Calendar integrations, so we can discuss connecting them to your chatbot.

inputs.question: What kinds of content can Magnify generate?

outputs.expected_answer: Examples include blog and SEO articles, e-commerce product descriptions, social posts and captions, email campaigns, website copy, job descriptions, HR documents, press releases, video scripts, podcast outlines, and technical documentation.

inputs.question: Can customers edit AI-generated content?

outputs.expected_answer: Yes. Generated content can be reviewed and edited. Magnify typically delivers it as a draft for customer approval and refinement.

inputs.question: How much content can Magnify produce per month?

outputs.expected_answer: For small projects, we can generate 10–20 pieces per month; for medium projects, 50–100; and for large projects, 200 or more.

inputs.question: What is the turnaround time for content projects?

outputs.expected_answer: Single articles take 24–48 hours; bulk content of 10–50 pieces takes 5–7 days; and large campaigns of 100 or more pieces take 2–3 weeks.

inputs.question: Give examples of workflows Magnify can automate.

outputs.expected_answer: Examples include lead capture into a CRM and email sequence; sales triggering inventory, shipping, and accounting updates; support-ticket alerts and assignment; social-mention analysis; document extraction into a database; invoice and payment tracking; and meeting booking with reminders.

inputs.question: Can Magnify integrate with custom internal software?

outputs.expected_answer: Yes. If the system has API or database access, Magnify can build a custom integration. It can also develop middleware when direct integration is not possible.

inputs.question: How reliable are Magnify's workflow integrations?

outputs.expected_answer: Our integrations include retry logic, monitoring and alerts, backups for critical workflows, and regular maintenance. We report 99.5%+ uptime.

inputs.question: What are the listed chatbot prices?

outputs.expected_answer: The listed prices are $1,500–$3,000 for a basic chatbot, $4,000–$8,000 for an advanced chatbot with integrations, and $10,000+ for an enterprise chatbot. Prices are in USD.

inputs.question: How much do workflow integrations cost?

outputs.expected_answer: Simple workflows involving 2–3 tools cost $500–$1,200, complex workflows involving 5 or more tools cost $2,000–$5,000, and enterprise integrations start at $8,000 USD.

inputs.question: Does Magnify offer payment plans?

outputs.expected_answer: Yes. For projects under $5,000, we offer 50% upfront and 50% on delivery. Larger projects can use milestone-based payments, and ongoing services can use monthly retainers.

inputs.question: What are the stages of Magnify's project process?

outputs.expected_answer: The process is: discovery call (30–60 minutes), proposal and quote (2–3 days), kickoff (1 week), development (2–6 weeks), testing and refinement (1 week), launch (1–2 days), and ongoing support.

inputs.question: What training and post-launch support are included?

outputs.expected_answer: Every project includes documentation and user guides, live team training, video tutorials, and 30 days of post-launch support.

inputs.question: What security practices does Magnify describe?

outputs.expected_answer: We use encryption for data transmission, secure cloud hosting with backups, and data-protection practices. NDAs are available, and customer data is not used to train public AI models.

inputs.question: Who owns the final product?

outputs.expected_answer: After final payment, you own the deliverables, including custom code and configurations, generated content, documentation, training materials, and integration credentials hosted in your accounts.

inputs.question: What happens if the solution does not work as promised?

outputs.expected_answer: If something doesn't work as promised, we fix it at no extra cost during the 30–90 day warranty period. We also test solutions before delivery and agree on acceptance criteria upfront.
